mapper.sql: exists(select 1 from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' and (d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id or find_in_set(p.company_dept_id,d.ancestors)))
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_project p where p.project_id=#{projectId} and p.del_flag='0' and

select p.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName from biz_project p where p.del_flag='0' and (p.main_owner_user_id=#{userId} or coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} or or exists(select 1 from biz_bonus_allocation b join biz_bonus_allocation_line l on l.allocation_id=b.allocation_id where b.project_id=p.project_id and b.status='APPROVED' and l.user_id=#{userId})) order by p.project_id desc

select u.user_id userId,coalesce((select nullif(m.user_name_snapshot,'') from biz_project_member m where m.project_id=#{projectId} and m.user_id=u.user_id limit 1),nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName from sys_user u where u.del_flag='0' and (exists(select 1 from biz_project_member m where m.project_id=#{projectId} and m.user_id=u.user_id) or exists(select 1 from biz_project p where p.project_id=#{projectId} and p.main_owner_user_id=u.user_id)) order by u.user_id
mapper.sql: allocation_id allocationId,award_id awardId,project_id projectId,status,mode,reason,request_key requestKey,amount, created_user_id createdUserId,created_user_name createdUserName,approved_user_id approvedUserId, approved_user_name approvedUserName,approved_time approvedTime,version
mapper.select: select from biz_bonus_allocation where project_id=#{projectId} order by allocation_id desc
select from biz_bonus_allocation where project_id=#{projectId} and request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.sql: l.line_id lineId,l.allocation_id allocationId,l.user_id userId,l.user_name userName,l.amount,l.percentage,l.reason, coalesce((select sum(p.amount) from biz_bonus_payment p where p.line_id=l.line_id and p.status='RECORDED'),0) paidAmount
mapper.select: select from biz_bonus_allocation_line l where l.allocation_id=#{allocationId} order by l.line_id
select from biz_bonus_allocation_line l where l.line_id=#{lineId}
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from biz_bonus_allocation where award_id=#{awardId} and status<>'CANCELED' and allocation_id<>#{excludeId}
select count(*) from biz_bonus_allocation where award_id=#{awardId} and status<>'CANCELED'
mapper.update: update biz_bonus_allocation set mode=#{mode},reason=#{reason},amount=#{amount},version=version+1 where allocation_id=#{allocationId} and version=#{version} and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED')
mapper.sql: p.payment_id paymentId,p.project_id projectId,p.line_id lineId,p.amount,p.paid_date paidDate,p.method, p.reference_no referenceNo,p.voucher,p.reason,p.request_key requestKey,p.status,p.recorded_user_id recordedUserId,p.recorded_user_name recordedUserName
mapper.select: select from biz_bonus_payment p join biz_bonus_allocation_line l on l.line_id=p.line_id where l.allocation_id=#{allocationId} order by p.payment_id desc
select from biz_bonus_payment p where p.project_id=#{projectId} and p.request_key=#{requestKey}
select from biz_bonus_payment p where p.line_id=#{lineId} and p.reference_no=#{referenceNo}
select event_id eventId,event_type eventType,operator_name operatorName,reason,snapshot,create_time createTime from biz_bonus_event where allocation_id=#{allocationId} order by event_id desc
